claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nitrofurazone is a nitroaromatic prodrug whose cytotoxicity at 2.5 uM likely depends on reductive activation by cellular nitroreductases such as NQO1/DT-diaphorase, generating reactive hydroxylamine/nitro radical species that damage DNA, so cells with high activating enzyme expression are expected to be selectively killed.
